prompt:
Consider the following company information, reported as of 2026-04-30. Act as a equity research analyst.
| Return 3m            | +16.7% |
| Return 1m            | +17.9% |
| Return 1w            | +3.3% |
| Range position (63d) | 100% |
| 21d realized vol     | 27% |
| Last close           | 91.50 |
Based only on the above and knowledge predating 2026-04-30, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock. Choose exactly one label from: BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has demonstrated very strong recent performance across all reported timeframes (3m, 1m, 1w), indicating significant positive momentum. The "Range position (63d)" at 100% suggests the stock is trading at its high for the past 63 trading days, reinforcing the strong upward trend. While a high range position could sometimes signal overbought conditions, the persistent positive returns across multiple periods generally support the continuation of the current trend, especially for a 20-trading-day horizon.

DECISION: BUY
